legend.headline: Do not use this medicine
legend.meaning: Not registered, on a NAFDAC alert, or the number belongs to a different product.
legend.nextStep: Don't take or sell it. Keep the pack, show it to a pharmacist, and report it to NAFDAC (0800-162-3322).

headline: Do not use this medicine

reasons.title: Registration number not found
reasons.message: 02-3457 is not in NAFDAC's registry. A medicine sold in Nigeria must carry a real NAFDAC number.
reasons.nextStep: Check you entered the number exactly as printed. If it is right, don't use the medicine and report it to NAFDAC (0800-162-3322).

reasons.title: On NAFDAC Public Alert 042/2026
reasons.message: NAFDAC warned about this batch on 19 Aug 2026 (Coordinated Wholesale Centre (CWC), Kano State): Public Alert No. 042/2026: seizure of suspected substandard and falsified BPPL Artemether/Lumefantrine 80mg/480mg.
reasons.nextStep: Don't use it. Keep the pack and report it to NAFDAC (0800-162-3322), quoting alert 042/2026.
